title: Cloudflare zones
description: Lists all Cloudflare zones visible to the token with status and pause state.

outputs.name: id
outputs.description: Zone identifier (needed by every per-zone API)

outputs.name: paused
outputs.description: True when Cloudflare is bypassed for the zone

template: SELECT id, name, status, paused FROM cloudflare.zones.zones;
notes: No parameters: scoping comes entirely from the token. A zone with status active but paused = true is proxied through DNS only, with Cloudflare features bypassed.
